newsitem.title: CHINA: China troops to enter HK before midnight June 30.
newsitem.headline: China troops to enter HK before midnight June 30.

text.p: China and Britain agreed on Monday to allow troops of China's People's Liberation Army to enter Hong Kong before the formal handover of power to Beijing at midnight on June 30, the Xinhua news agency said.
A total of 509 officers and men of the People's Liberation Army (PLA), and 39 vehicles, will cross the border into Hong Kong at 9.00 p.m. (1300 GMT) on June 30, Xinhua said.

"The purpose of the agreement concluded by the two sides is to ensure that the PLA be able to perform its defence duties in Hong Kong from zero hour of July 1," it quoted a Chinese official as saying.
He said he was confident Chinese and British troops would transfer defence responsibilities in Hong Kong smoothly.
A small PLA advance guard is already in Hong Kong but there had been disagrement over whether more Chinese troops would be allowed to enter the territory in advance of the handover.
